description: Five diverse true/false inputs: a clearly true statement, a clearly false statement, a subtle wrong-quantity case (intermediate), an inferential advanced case, and an insufficient-source.

cases.name: clearly_true_beginner

input.source_content: The Sun is at the center of our solar system. Eight planets orbit the Sun. In order from the Sun, they are: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Pluto, once considered the ninth planet, was reclassified as a dwarf planet by the International Astronomical Union in 2006.

expected_constraints: body is a declarative sentence, NOT a question

cases.name: clearly_false_beginner

input.source_content: The Sun is at the center of our solar system. Eight planets orbit the Sun. Pluto, once considered the ninth planet, was reclassified as a dwarf planet by the International Astronomical Union in 2006.

expected_constraints: if statement is false, explanation identifies which specific clause is wrong
false statement is not just a 'true statement with an absolute word added' (no trick falsity)

cases.name: subtle_wrong_quantity_intermediate

input.source_content: The adult human body contains 206 bones. The skeleton supports the body, protects internal organs, and works with muscles to enable movement. Babies are born with about 270 bones, many of which fuse together as they grow.

expected_constraints: intermediate distortion = correct concept, wrong quantity/actor/date
the falsity is checkable against the source

cases.name: inferential_advanced

input.source_content: Newton's first law states that an object at rest will remain at rest, and an object in motion will continue in motion at a constant velocity, unless acted upon by an external force. This property is called inertia. The second law quantifies the relationship: F = ma, where F is force, m is mass, and a is acceleration. The third law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction.

expected_constraints: advanced statement requires inference or application
answer derivable from source via reasoning, not surface match

input.source_content: A computer's CPU executes instructions stored in memory.
